statement.text:
Describe the finite groups generated by a conjugacy class D of involutions
which satisfies the following property: if a, b ∈ D and |ab| = 4, then [a, b] ∈ D.
This condition is satisfied, for example, in the case where D is a conjugacy class of
involutions of a known finite simple group such that ⟨CD (a)⟩ is a 2-group for every
a ∈ D.                                                                A. A. Makhnëv
